messages:
Maria: quick check — want to enable `eu_fallback_v2` for 5% of EU1 traffic for 2h. Route to model `rwd-lite-fallback` when primary latency > 500ms. Guardrails: stickiness=false, ttl=15m, circuit-breaker if 5xx > 1% over 5m. No writes to downstream systems (read-only). Need SRE + infra ack. @Lee @Tom

Tom: are we scoping EU1 only or all EU regions? also prefer ramp over 10m instead of instant 5%.

Devon: scope EU1 only, 5% ramp over 10m sounds good. opened PR for the flag + rollout policy: https://gh.redwood/repo/pull/1234

Devon: config preview:
```json
{
  "flag": "eu_fallback_v2",
  "scope": {"region": "eu1", "pct": 5},
  "stickiness": false,
  "ttl_minutes": 15,
  "circuit_breaker": {"5xx_pct": 1.0, "window_mins": 5},
  "read_only": true
}
```

Lee: oncall ok for a 13:30–15:30 UTC window. I'll be watching errors + latency. runbook: rollback if 5xx > 1.5% sustained for 3m.

Ann: add dashboards: eu1-token-latency (p50/p95), model-error-rate, fallback-cost-per-token. we need an alert for error rate and p95 spike.

sre-bot: created alert rule `eu_fallback_errors` -> trigger when error_rate > 1.2% over 3m (URL: https://mon.redwood/alerts/456)

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled at 1872105000 (canary window + ramp). preview: https://deploy.redwood/rollouts/789

Tom: infra note — make sure cache key namespace separates fallback: `fallback:v2:<request_id>`. also check KV capacity for TTLs. pinging @infra for a quick CR.

Devon: PR merged to staging; will run canary job against staging next.

Maria: thanks — plan is to flip at 13:30 UTC if no objections. :thumbsup:

Lee: ack — I'll watch. :eyes:

Maria: flipping now (starting rollout) — will post 5m/10m/30m updates.

deploy-bot: rollout started at 1872105000 (job id r-2026-09-01-789)

Maria: 5m update: p50 unchanged, p95 improved ~60ms, errors stable at ~0.4%. continuing to monitor.

Tom: looks good. if metrics stay stable we can consider increasing to 10% after 30m.

Maria: noted — will pause and rollback on any spike. thanks everyone for the quick responses.
